---
description: Execute the next AAE specification task with bounded evidence
---

Identify the next ready task in the applicable `.aae/specs/` task ledger. Acquire only its linked requirements, design decisions, constraints, repository precedents, effective testing preferences, and verification commands. Implement the bounded outcome, create and run configured tests, evaluate resource-lifecycle checks when the behavior is repeated or resource-owning, record evidence, obtain independent review when risk requires it, and update task status accurately. When tests are disabled or impractical, record justified alternative verification. Persist durable lessons before clearing stale working context.
